title: Midgame Control & Hub Hunts
youtubeTitle: Subspace Lattice Academy Ep.3 — Standard Battle (57 Plies)
description: Mission 2: opening structure, midgame net pressure, and a Surgical Strike finish. Quiet stretches scrub; turning points pause.

scenes.headline: Midgame Control
scenes.subhead: A fixed 57-ply fleet game — chess ballpark. Infiltrators omitted so the story stays on Escorts, Beams, and the Hub hunt.
scenes.voiceover: Episode three: a standard battle. Fifty-seven plies. We won’t crawl every quiet step — we’ll scrub the openings, slow down for trades, and stop when the Hub hunt becomes real.
Starting seat under hybrid-fleet with the clock disarmed for teaching. White’s Initiative Relay Escort is already forward. Goal: Surgical Strike — not racing to paint the map.

scenes.caption: Opening · Beams inside the glow, Escorts linking
scenes.voiceover: Opening, plies one through fourteen. Both sides slide Beams inside their Sensor Net glow, then advance central Escorts to link coverage and contest the midboard. Structure first — gambits later.
Ply seventeen. Long Beam slides mean the net already covers the path. White is preparing lanes — not fishing for random captures.

scenes.caption: Midgame · net pressure & trades
scenes.voiceover: Midgame stretch. Escort chains push, Target Locks appear, Beams and Escorts trade at key intersections. Typical play is net pressure and probing for a Hub mistake — not a Go race.

scenes.prompt: Defenders are thinning. Can White force Surgical Strike?
scenes.voiceover: Late game. Pause and predict: with key defenders removed, does White have a walk-in on the Hub?
scenes.revealVoiceover: Ply fifty-seven. White delivers Surgical Strike. Same lesson as Mission One — just earned over a full game: clear the lane, refuse hangs, strike when the Hub is forced.

scenes.headline: When Hubs survive, the clock decides
scenes.voiceover: That length is normal when the Hub hunt succeeds. Next episode: what happens when both fleets dig in — and Sector Integration becomes the win condition.
